meta.project: ORBITAL-1 / Vision-Based On-Board Diagnostics for Hypervelocity Impact Characterization (IAC 2026)
meta.revision: v2 (2026-09-03) - micro / near-micro framing doctrine: the damage feature is the ONLY subject, centered, filling most of the frame; wide shots, full panels and whole-spacecraft scenes are explicitly negated. Filenames use the same seeds as v1, so ALWAYS generate into a fresh output folder.

meta.note: v2 framing doctrine: every image is an extreme close-up at micro or near-micro scale. The damage is the only subject, centered, occupying most of the frame; only the damaged area and its immediately surrounding surface may be visible. No full panels, no whole spacecraft, no scenery, no visible planet or terrain. Vacuum physics: no fire, smoke, flames or rust in orbit; keep them high-weight in the negative prompt. Vary the seed on every image.

damage_classes.label: crater
damage_classes.positive_core: (a single hemispherical hypervelocity impact crater:1.45) as the only subject, perfectly centered, (the crater fills most of the frame:1.35), raised curled molten rim lips in razor sharp detail, smooth bowl-shaped cavity, bright exposed bare metal inside the crater, fine radial ejecta spray marks immediately around the rim, no penetration, only the crater and its immediate rim visible, nothing else in the frame

severity.minor: tiny sub-millimeter crater imaged at very high magnification so it still spans about one third of the frame, barely raised rim
severity.moderate: 5 mm hemispherical crater imaged up close, spanning about half of the frame, pronounced molten lip, thin ejecta ring
severity.severe: large deep crater spanning about two thirds of the frame, wide melted rim, ring of cracked coating around the cavity, near-marginal penetration bulge

damage_classes.negative_extra: through hole, penetration, light shining through, torn petals, radial crack network, shattered glass, spall, cluster of pits, second crater, multiple craters, crater small in frame

severity.severe: 20 mm ragged through-hole spanning about two thirds of the frame, deformed bulged metal around the opening, torn coating at the rim

damage_classes.negative_extra: shallow crater, closed cavity, intact back surface, bent petals, spider-web cracks, torn fabric, multiple pits, second hole, multiple holes, hole small in frame

lighting.light_direct: harsh direct unfiltered sunlight, extreme contrast, pitch-black hard-edged shadows, no atmospheric scattering, blown specular highlights on bare metal
lighting.light_grazing: grazing low-angle sunlight raking across the surface, terminator lighting, long micro-shadows inside craters and pits emphasizing depth relief
lighting.light_led: eclipse darkness illuminated by a cool white LED inspection lamp, small specular hotspot on the damage, vignetted pool of light, surrounding pitch blackness
lighting.light_albedo: soft bluish fill light reflected from Earth below, gentle earthshine illumination lifting the shadows
lighting.light_glint: strong specular sun glint reflecting off the metallic surface, high dynamic range, bright star-shaped reflection right next to the damage

camera.cam_micro: microscope-level inspection view at sub-millimeter scale, material grain and machining marks clearly resolved, the subject occupying nearly the entire frame, flat top-down perspective, deep depth of field
camera.cam_macro: extreme macro lens close-up at millimeter scale, the subject filling most of the frame, top-down view, fine surface grain visible, deep depth of field
camera.cam_close: tight close-up from a few centimeters, the subject large, centered and filling more than half of the frame, slight perspective
camera.cam_oblique: oblique 45-degree macro close-up across the surface, camera very close to the panel, foreshortened relief on the subject which still fills the frame

backgrounds.bg_fill: the surface fills the frame completely edge to edge, no background visible at all
backgrounds.bg_edge_space: only a thin sliver of pure black space visible along one edge of the frame, everything else is the surface
backgrounds.bg_vignette: the surface fading into deep shadow at the frame corners, no scenery, no objects
backgrounds.bg_bokeh: extreme background blur, a faint out-of-focus dark hardware bokeh in one corner of the frame, no recognizable objects

dataset_plan.diversity_rule: cross lighting x camera x background x severity within each class; no single combination above 15% of a class; unique seed per image
dataset_plan.real_data_note: Mix real imagery (NASA LDEF crater archive, returned Hubble array photos, Sentinel-1A damage image, ISS inspection photos) into val/test to measure the sim-to-real gap
